# aplyx

> aplyx is a local-first job-application agent. It searches job boards, deduplicates against
> your local history, checks each posting against your preferences with deterministic logic
> (not a model's guess), tailors a resume and cover letter, and applies through a browser or
> public APIs, with every application reviewable before it goes out.

## What it is

- A terminal app (TUI) and a native desktop app (built with Tauri), both driven by the same
  local-first core. Runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
- A browser extension (Manifest V3) that detects a real application form on Greenhouse, Lever,
  Ashby, or Workday, offers to autofill it from your profile, and never submits without you.
- Searches Ashby, Lever, Greenhouse, Workday, SmartRecruiters, and other job boards in one pass.
- Free and open source (MIT license) for local use: no account, no waitlist, no cost.
- Requires a coding agent to drive it locally: full capability, including browser-automated
  applies, with opencode or Claude Code; a smaller, API-fed-boards-only path with Codex CLI or
  GitHub Copilot CLI.
- A hosted account tier is planned (search, tailoring, and auto-apply from aplyx's own servers,
  no local install or coding agent required) but is not live yet; pricing shown on the site is
  illustrative and not final.

## Privacy

- Running locally, your profile, resumes, and application history stay on your own machine and
  are never uploaded by aplyx itself.
- A hosted account additionally stores your profile and resume file(s) in a cloud database
  (Supabase-backed), scoped to your account.
- Resume tailoring and cover-letter drafting send the relevant job description and resume text
  to whichever coding agent's model provider you're using, the same as using that agent directly.
- Discord status updates and a Google Sheets tracking sync are both opt-in and off by default.
- Full detail: https://aplyx.app/privacy.html
